about_the_game:
As Inky, you’ll venture through his eerie dreamscape — deciphering arcane glyph puzzles, crawling through boxes that open into hidden dimensions, chasing a mischievous ball of living yarn, and evading dark ghastly creatures that infest the dream. Venture inward to the depths to dispel the gloom from beyond.

Game Features

  • A spine-chilling claustrophobic atmosphere intertwined with unexpected humorous and cute moments.

  • The main storyline is conveyed through visual imagery and emotions, remaining almost understandable without words.

  • The rich sound design, coupled with the mesmerizing melodies written by Stewart Keller (composer of Juice Galaxy), will give you a vivid audio experience.

  • Challenging puzzles, many of which have randomized solutions.

  • Simple and intuitive controls.

  • Creepy, grotesque monsters.

  • Discover hidden rooms containing beautiful collars for Inky.
